verdict.rationale: Name.com ships an official MCP server (name-com-docs-9, name-com-probe-4) that lets AI agents like Cursor/Claude Desktop invoke Core API operations (domain registration, DNS, transfers, WHOIS privacy, etc.) via natural-language commands, plus a read-only docs MCP server for citation support (name-com-docs-19) and a skill.md describing agent-usable domain management actions (name-com-docs-23). missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server's real-world reliability and breadth of natural-language command coverage beyond vendor docs.
